blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Quezon province is pursuing Geographical Indication (GI) status for its iconic coconut-based liquor, lambanog, to protect the product’s identity and heritage, strengthen its market recognition, and expand business opportunities for local producers. The initiative, dubbed “Tatak at Pinagmulan: Tungo sa Geographical Indication (GI) ng Lambanog ng Quezon” (Brand and Origin: Toward a Geographical Indication for Quezon Lambanog), involves a series of stakeholder consultations led by the Agricultural Training Institute Regional Training Center in Calabarzon in partnership with the Office of the Provincial Agriculturist of Quezon and other members of the technical working group, according to a report released […]...
